name: Domain Shift with Formalized Bottleneck Recurrence
description: Shifts the domain from generic operations/tasks to freight train inspections to evade NLP pattern matching for job-shop problems. Retains the explicit structural rules (exactly two stages, same permutation, single capacity) to perfectly preserve the contract. Adds a rigorous mathematical recurrence ($B_k = \max(A_k, B_{k-1}) + c_k$) to define the timeline unambiguously, which forces models to reason about the algebraic properties of the bottleneck rather than relying on standard English boilerplate that triggers "Johnson's Rule" memorization.
